title: Deploy succeeds but no tile appears on the Fiori Launchpad
symptom: The deploy reports success and the app runs at its direct URL (/sap/bc/ui5_ui5/sap/<app>/index.html), but users do not see a tile in the Launchpad.
rootCause:
Not fully verified. Deploy only creates the BSP app and the LADI; a visible tile additionally requires the whole assignment chain: LADI -> Business Catalog -> Business Role -> Business User.

Two common breaks:
- manifest.json has no crossNavigation, so no LADI is generated
- the LADI exists but was never added to a catalog or role

solutions.label: Walk the assignment chain in order
solutions.body:
1. Does manifest.json contain sap.app.crossNavigation.inbounds?
2. Does LADI <APPNAME>_UI5R exist in ADT?
3. Custom Catalog Extensions app: has the app been added to a Business Catalog?
4. Maintain Business Roles app: has that catalog been assigned to the user's role?

Stop at the first step that fails — later steps are meaningless until it passes.

solutions.label: Clear the user's Launchpad cache
solutions.body: Not verified. If everything is assigned correctly and the tile still does not appear, sign out and back in, or open the Launchpad in a private window to rule out browser caching.

prevention: Put those four steps in the Definition of Done for every Fiori app. A successful deploy does not mean a usable app.
